adjacentOwnedExtension: AuthoredPlacementRuntime publish:false and sampleFreeTransforms allow multiple cinematic free props to reuse its selected-source renderer without modifying game placement metadata/navigation. Default editor publication remains unchanged and its eleven focused tests pass.
hypothesis: Use the existing world/scene/FrameLoop/tool lease and prepared actor/static resource paths, with one absolute pose adapter shared by editor scrubbing and game playback. Keep new actors visual-only and independently posed, retain bounded warm resources, and release input/camera/audio ownership through the existing lease.

api.poseAdapter: createCinematicPoseSampler(encounter) evaluates authored registered clip channels absolutely, preserving scalar/vector/quaternion interpolation and at most two weighted clips from the shared evaluator.

implementation.sceneOwnership: No new Engine, Scene, RAF, AudioContext or permanent scene observer. Root's acquireToolLease owns input/held-action cancellation, HUD, free camera controls, pause and tracked audio; the existing FrameLoop invokes the player's update callback.
implementation.camera: Apply evaluated map-space position/look-at target/FOV radians to the existing camera; zero inertia, temporarily remove shot-clamping limits, and restore only with the same scene/map/ground/tool-generation ownership. Studio converts captured WORLD coordinates into anchor-local coordinates exactly once.
implementation.actors: Reuse createActorEncounterFactory and warm/prepareHidden only. No summon, brain, collision, reward or BossBattle update runs for cinematic actors. Current toon, outline/internal-line, shadow and shader preparation paths remain intact; independent skeleton/pose/morph instances share eligible base resources.
implementation.sampling: Babylon Animation.evaluate samples registered native channel interpolation without an AnimationGroup clock or pending weighted goToFrame queue. Empty animation lists restore prepared idle at0. Existing root/ground correction is applied absolutely. Mourning reuses its approved knee tracks and morph/halo/cloth methods with explicit absolute clocks and fresh cloth target initialization, making seek independent of prior playback.
implementation.skinPaletteFix: Independent actual-rig verification found that Skeleton.prepare() reused palettes within one render ID even though local channels matched. Use the public prepare(true) flag after a newly sampled pose; a linked Bone/Skeleton regression proves distinct and restored palettes between seeks without incrementing render ID. The scene draw reuses the resulting palette.
implementation.statics: Only selected approved static props load through the existing placement runtime in nonpublishing mode. sampleFreeTransforms applies multiple owned free non-colliding props synchronously, without per-frame commit or shader preparation.
implementation.boundInstances: Existing loaded static instances are read-only: enforce asset/version identity, exact immutable transform and no transform/animation tracks. Base normalized-root scale and authored overlay multiplier-on-root scale use their respective existing conventions; their collision/navigation never changes.
implementation.events: sample/seek emits no SFX or gameplay events. emit accepts configured audio IDs and marker diagnostics only; player cue deduplication and audio lease tracking remain authoritative.
implementation.cleanup: One idempotent release path hides/retires only owned actors/static visuals, stops owned audio, cancels existing preparation lifetimes, and releases the same lease. Late acquisition/preparation is reclaimed. Map/death/context/error cancellation retires affected owned resources and never restores an old-map actor or camera.

bounds.idlePolicy: Sweep on the next explicit acquire/prepare or evictIdle call, with immediate pressure eviction; no background interval. Active/retiring resources stay charged. Host disposal releases all owned cache entries.
bounds.capBehavior: Reject explicit overflow; do not silently reduce actor counts. Definition estimates reserve bytes before warm, then adapter estimates are checked after preparation. These are conservative reservations/CPU estimates, not measured GPU residency.

independentEvidence.staticResult: Normalized authored overlay binding worked without a clone; identity/transform/track conflicts rejected. Two free props shared geometry over41 samples with zero world placement publishes; ten load/seek/stop cycles had an exact resource plateau.
independentEvidence.lifecycleResult: Actual lease pause, map cancellation and idle cleanup passed with zero remaining timers and matching current source hashes.
independentEvidence.scope: NullEngine actual packed geometry, rigs, clips, morphs, native CPU draw and ownership paths with opaque1x1 material fixtures. No browser, pixels, actual image decoding, GPU, physical-device FPS or thermal result.
